faces.name: Mr. Monopoly, On the Go
faces.oracleText:
0: Roll a six-sided die. Put a number of loyalty counters on Mr. Monopoly equal to the result.
−2: Heist! — Exile the top two cards of target opponent's library. Until end of turn, you may play those cards, and mana of any type can be spent to cast them.
−4: Shut Down! — Destroy target artifact.
−40: Pass Go — Create 200 Treasure tokens.
